customManagers.description: Track the zlib release stevedore builds its deflate from.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/zlib/version but cannot vouch for the new tarball, so the build fails at the fetch until components/zlib/sha256 is written for it.
prBodyNotes: The build fails until components/zlib/sha256 matches the new tarball: run `sh build/pin-zlib.sh` on this branch (it checks GitHub's tarball against zlib.net's), regenerate tests/fixtures/gz with `sh tests/fixtures/gz/generate.sh` if the deflate output moved, and commit both.
